subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I don't prefer to remain alone at home in the evenings because loneliness evokes a sense of __melancholy __and grief within me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"melancholy"** means a deep, long-lasting sadness. (उदासी)

 
 
• **Example: **After hearing the news of the tragedy, she was overcome with melancholy.
 
 
 
• **"Cheerfulness" **refers to a state of being noticeably happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्नता)
 
 
• **Example: **His cheerfulness was infectious, and soon everyone in the room was smiling.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'melancholy'** is **'cheerfulness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Readiness **(तत्परता): The state of being fully prepared for something.

 
 
• **Example:** His readiness to help was appreciated by all.
 
 
 
• **Absoluteness **(पूर्णता): The quality of being absolute or complete.
 
 
• **Example: **She spoke with an absoluteness that left no room for doubt.
 
 
 
• **Shyness **(संकोच): The quality or state of being shy.
 
 
• **Example: **Her shyness made it difficult for her to make new friends.
